plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Architectural Design Technology A.S. Degree - Architectural Design Technology-Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 28, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7821/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local. Map states Total Units 61-63.5; lower bound 61 encoded = 15+15+15+16 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 2 elective 3-3.5 -> 3; Sem 3 ADT 320/ARCH 329 -> 3; Sem 4 ADT 324/ARCH 334 -> 3 and ADT 326/ARCH 332/ARCH 342 -> 3). Map notes this program also meets the requirements for the Certificate of Achievement in Building Information Modeling (BIM) and the Certificate of Achievement in Interior Building Architecture (IBA); no separate sequences are published for those certificates. ELECTIVE SUGGESTIONS AND CO-REQUISITES: Semester 1 elective suggestion is ARCH 320 Architectural Design & Communication I (3.5 units), co-requisite with ARCH 325 (the elective is listed at 3 units; the 3.5-unit suggestion is documented here). Semester 2 (3-3.5 unit) elective suggestion is ARCH 321 Architectural Design & Communication II (3.5 units), co-requisite with ARCH 326. Semester 3 elective suggestion is CMT 310 Materials of Construction (3 units; advisory CMT 300). ARCH 320/321 are suggestions only, not sequenced courses; their co-requisite links to ARCH 325/326 are documented here, not encoded as plan prerequisites. SEMESTER 4 CHOICE GROUPS: (1) ADT 324 BIM III (prerequisite per map: ADT 322 or experience; advisory ADT 310 & 320) or ARCH 334 Advanced Design in Three Dimensions (prerequisite per map: ARCH 320; advisory ARCH 321); (2) ADT 326 BIM IV (prerequisite per map: ADT 322 or equivalent; advisory ADT 310 & 320) or ARCH 332 Design Awareness (prerequisite per map: ARCH 320 & 321, listed bare in the prerequisite column) or ARCH 342 Introduction to Green Buildings. Option-specific prerequisites are documented here rather than encoded on the choice slots, because the 'or experience'/'or equivalent' alternatives and the ARCH 320/321 suggested-elective prerequisites do not map to single plan courses. ADT 322 prerequisite per map: ADT 320 or experience (ADT 320 is the Semester 3 choice-slot code). Other advisories: ADT 310 advisory ADT 300 & 302; ADT 320 advisory ADT 310; ARCH 329 advisory ARCH 321 & 326. Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level.
